technical.summary: Strong trend structure with extreme overbought conditions and bearish stochastic cross signal caution; high volume and ADX strength support bullish bias but momentum indicators suggest pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 47 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signals from junior Republicans combined with market fear (VIX-like conditions) and neutral AAII sentiment suggest contrarian buying opportunity, but conviction is limited by small transaction sizes and lack of senior member participation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (401.76) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event create severely adverse macro conditions; earnings in 47 days adds moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX trend structure with 15x volume spike and contrarian fear-zone opportunity provide technical foundation for entry despite overbought conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis regime (401.76), multiple overbought momentum divergences (RSI/Stoch/Williams %R), price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, zero fundamental conviction, and imminent earnings binary risk create prohibitive risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Strong ADX trend and 15x volume spike provide technical structure, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 9, Stoch, Williams %R) combined with crisis VIX regime (401.76) create prohibitive risk/reward for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis environment with multiple momentum divergences suggests imminent pullback or reversal; earnings binary in 47 days adds uncompensated timing risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding LMT with 45 existing Industrials positions (19.5% sector concentration); adding to concentration during crisis macro regime is imprudent.
